response.justification: Bogdan brings well over a decade of full-stack engineering experience that comfortably exceeds the 6+ year bar, with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, and AWS at Optilyz, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling work at re:cinq — a specifically requested and relatively rare skill. He has a CS degree, strong testing credentials (built his own D test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium/TDD courses), and DevOps exposure with Docker and Kubernetes. The main gaps are stack-specific rather than fundamental: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Kotlin, or PostgreSQL experience listed, and a significant portion of his systems depth is in DLang, a niche language. Given his demonstrated polyglot adaptability, these gaps are likely quick to close, and he is a strong interview candidate.
strengths: 15+ years full-stack breadth with recent TypeScript/Node/React/AWS delivery
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience, matching a hard-to-find requirement
Deep testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, taught courses)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest experience on the resume
Kotlin absent and relational DB depth (PostgreSQL) unclear — mostly MongoDB/MySQL
Heavy investment in DLang and Ember.js, which are niche relative to the target stack

key_factors.factor: Missing specific framework/tooling matches (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
